summary: A collaborative open-source display font by 30+ Upstate New York designers, each glyph drawn by someone else. The page is a long wall of ~105 poster-coloured glyph cards, each crediting its author, followed by full-bleed colour bands of editable sentences that show off the deliberately mismatched mashup.

instances.look: 'EXCELSIORAMA' at ~174px on charcoal with each letter a different drawing and colour (cyan, lime, purple, orange, yellow), one line of white monospace below, and a small fixed white 'A/a' chip at top centre
instances.feel: A carnival poster from a group show
instances.ux: Static; the fixed A/a chip (attached here, never cut as a block) stays on screen and toggles the size of the glyph-wall cards
instances.learn: When every letter has a different author, let colour separate them: the wordmark explains the concept on its own

reconstruction.layout: Centred 940px box, ~519px tall on #232323; word at ~y=230, tagline at ~y=450; chip 48×28px fixed at top centre, white
reconstruction.typography: Name ~174px Excelsiorama, fitted with FitText (0.5); tagline 16px monospace white; chip ~10px bold
reconstruction.content: 'A typeface made by graphic designers living and working in "Upstate" (not NYC) New York.'
reconstruction.html: h1#headline with per-letter colour spans; a#size 'A/a'

instances.look: A wall of ~105 tall five-across cards, each a flat colour (lime, cyan, yellow, pink, purple, orange, grey) with one white glyph cropped by the card, a hairline, the contributor's name in Six Caps and a @handle; alternates carry a black 'ALT' tag
instances.feel: Trading cards, a wall of gig posters
instances.ux: Each handle links to the contributor's Twitter; the fixed A/a chip toggles .small on the cards so the wall shrinks
instances.learn: Turn the character set into a credit roll: each cell names who drew the letter, so the glyph table becomes the 'about' section and contributors have a card to share

reconstruction.layout: Five columns, 1020px wide total centred on charcoal; cards ~202×336px with 3px gaps; ~21 rows, 8932px tall. Glyph oversized and clipped by the card (overflow hidden); name and handle fixed near the bottom. Colour order cycles through 7 colours
reconstruction.typography: Glyph ~160px+ excelsiorama, white; name ~24px Six Caps uppercase black under a 1px rule; handle ~10px Arial Black or Helvetica Neue Bold; 'ALT' tag ~8px white on black
reconstruction.behaviour: #size click toggles .on on itself and .small on all .on elements (cards). Links open Twitter. No hover glyph detail
reconstruction.content: Whole set in order: A–Z, a–z, figures, punctuation, currency, then alternates (ss01). Real contributors
reconstruction.html: ul > li.on[.alt] > span.letter + div.container > h2 + a.cta

instances.look: 'UPSTNY' at 268px in near-black on charcoal, barely visible, each letter a different hand
instances.learn: A tone-on-tone word makes a quiet divider between a loud wall and loud bands (or the per-letter colour classes failed; only one span's class looks misspelled in the HTML, so the darkness may be a bug)

instances.look: Three full-bleed colour bands, each with one centred editable pangram: cyan on yellow, black on sky blue ('hamburgefonstiv'), yellow on pink, then a bordered dark 'TYPE SOMETHING' box
instances.ux: Click and type on any band; the last field empties itself on focus. No controls, no labels
instances.learn: One colour pair per editable band: with no toolbar, each field shows a different mood and a different test string

reconstruction.layout: Stacked full-width bands of 724, 434 and 360px, with centred text; then 1300×244px outlined field on charcoal
reconstruction.typography: Yellow band: ~130px caps; blue band: ~134px (FitText 1) lowercase; pink band: ~90px lowercase; field ~100px grey text; all Excelsiorama, centred, wrapping
reconstruction.behaviour: p#rando, p#pangram and h2#upstny are contenteditable with spellcheck off; textarea onfocus clears contents. Band sizes fixed by content
reconstruction.content: 'THE QUICK BROWN FOX JUMPS OVER THE LAZY DOG', 'hamburgefonstiv', 'pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs', 'TYPE SOMETHING'

instances.look: A single paragraph of 16px monospace on charcoal explaining the project and linking to Github
instances.ux: Links to Github and two Twitter accounts
instances.learn: A plain mono README paragraph is a good foil after a loud mashup, and asks for use in return

reconstruction.content: '…completed by over 30 collaborators… Contributors snagged glyphs on a first come first served basis, with zero direction and guidance.'

instances.look: Yellow 'DOWNLOAD EXCELSIORAMA' button in 18px monospace red-orange on charcoal, linking to the Github zip
Dark band with three tiny grey logos typed from the font's own custom glyphs ('_ + \ + •': a heart, AIGA, a signature) joined by plus signs
instances.ux: Each glyph links to AIGA's Slack, AIGA Upstate NY and the developer
instances.learn: Draw the partner logos as glyphs and the credit line is typed in the font itself

reconstruction.typography: ~50px excelsiorama for the logo glyphs, monospace '+', grey
